    # Get pre-configured resources
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    diluent = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # === Protocol Parameters ===
    num_wells = 8          # Serial dilution across 8 wells (A1-A8)
    transfer_vol = 50      # µL transferred between wells per dilution step
    diluent_vol = 50       # µL of diluent pre-loaded into receiving wells
    initial_sample_vol = 100  # µL total sample in well A1 (2x 50 µL aspirations)
    mix_volume = 50        # µL mixing volume (half of well content)
    mix_reps = 3           # Number of mix cycles after each dilution

    # Destination wells: A1 through A8 of destination plate
    dest_wells = [dest[f"A{i}"] for i in range(1, num_wells + 1)]

    # Helper to generate sequential tip rack positions (column-major)
    def get_tip_pos(index):

    dest_wells = [dest[f"A{i}"] for i in range(1, num_wells + 1)]

    # Helper to generate sequential tip rack positions (column-major)
    def get_tip_pos(index):
        row = index % 8
        col = index // 8 + 1
        return f"{chr(ord('A') + row)}{col}"

    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[get_tip_pos(tip_index)])

    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[get_tip_pos(tip_index)])

    # --- Access pre-configured deck resources ---
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # --- Protocol parameters ---
    # 50 uL tips: every aspirate/dispense volume stays below tip capacity
    # to avoid overflow warnings during simulation.
    SAMPLE_VOLUME = 40   # uL of sample transferred per well
    REAGENT_VOLUME = 10  # uL of reagent added per well
    WELLS = ["A1", "B1", "C1", "D1", "E1", "F1", "G1", "H1"]  # column 1

    try:
        # --- Step 1: Transfer samples from source plate to destination plate ---
        # Fresh tips are used per sample to prevent cross-contamination.
        for well in WELLS:
            # Pick up a fresh 50 uL tip (column 1 of the tip rack)
            await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[well])

            # Aspirate sample from the source plate (40 uL < 50 uL tip capacity)
            await lh.aspirate(source[well], vols=[SAMPLE_VOLUME])

            # Dispense sample into the matching destination well
            await lh.dispense(dest[well], vols=[SAMPLE_VOLUME])

            # Discard tips after each sample transfer
            await lh.drop_tips()

        # --- Step 2: Add reagent to every destination well ---
        # The same reagent is dispensed to all wells, so a single tip set
        # can be reused safely (per-well volume stays below tip capacity).
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A2"])
        for well in WELLS:
            # Aspirate reagent from the first trough channel
            await lh.aspirate(trough["A1"], vols=[REAGENT_VOLUME])
            # Dispense reagent into the destination well
            await lh.dispense(dest[well], vols=[REAGENT_VOLUME])
        # Discard reagent tips when finished
        await lh.drop_tips()

    except Exception as exc:
        # Report any failure and re-raise so the error is not silently swallowed
        print(f"--- PROTOCOL_ERROR: {exc} ---")
        raise

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")
```
